snippet.title: Get to Work, Gnomes! Christmas Factory - Teaser | Now Live on Steam!
snippet.description:
🎮 Wishlist now on Steam!: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4447620/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=steam_page_launch

🎄 Can you survive the chaos of a Christmas gift factory and save Christmas with these unruly gnomes?
Get to Work, Gnomes! Christmas Factory is a fast-paced, chaotic management game.
You drag lazy gnomes back to work, build production lines, and pump out as many gifts as possible before Christmas.

➡️ Twitter/X: https://twitter.com/tiny_workers
➡️ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/tinyworkers_official
➡️ Support Us!: https://www.patreon.com/cw/TinyWorkers
